== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Friendly Fire (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Friendly Fire]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/friendly_fire_japanese_white_border/50627 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/c93e45f092b340d288ee01b78f4f64d6/IMG_20220607_0117.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(10, 8, 762, 1070)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7a3f7e4f77bdbd725607527648cd70fcdbd7634fabf5316ec92600ec791d3ef8</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
